course.name: MBBS Medicine
course.notes: Standard-entry MBBS Medicine A100. Graduate Entry Medicine A101 is separate and must not be merged into this profile.

selection_approach_display: Queen Mary University of London ranks supported school-leaver applicants using UCAT and academic strength within separate Home and International applicant pools, but does not publish the exact current weighting.

medical_school.name: Barts and The London School of Medicine and Dentistry
medical_school.notes: Rules are mapped only from QMUL-A100-Production-Research.md and QMUL-A100-Implementation-Mapping.md.

applicant_pools.selection_relevance: Eligible standard Home school-leavers are considered in the Home pool. ApplySmart may show Limited/Medium-confidence predictive interview guidance derived from official historical admissions statistics; this is not an official QMUL threshold.

Eligible Overseas school-leavers are considered in the Overseas pool. ApplySmart may show Limited/Medium-confidence predictive interview guidance derived from official historical admissions statistics; this is not an official QMUL threshold.
Contextual, care-experienced and widening-participation flags are qualitative manual-review overlays only.
A100 graduate applicants require manual review because the degree score and graduate-specific cut-offs are unpublished.

overall_policy.description: QMUL first checks academic minimums, UCAT at or above the 4th decile and SJT Bands 1-3. SJT Band 4 is an automatic rejection.
not_eligible_if: The applicable academic minimum requirements are not met.
UCAT is below the official 4th decile boundary for the relevant test year.
Required English-language evidence is missing or below the published requirement where it applies.

grade_requirements.notes: English Literature can satisfy the required-subject presence in the dossier, but English Language 6/B is the executable English-language exemption route.

accepted_equivalencies: Science Double Award may substitute all sciences at GCSE, subject to manual review of applicant evidence.
manual_review_overlays: English Literature used for required-subject presence without GCSE or IGCSE English Language 6/B evidence.
Combined Science or Double Award substitution.
International applicants who did not study GCSE or IGCSE qualifications.
gcse.sitting_policy: No separate GCSE resit restriction was found in the supplied dossier.
gcse.notes: GCSEs are an eligibility gate only; QMUL does not publish a GCSE points system for A100 interview ranking.

standard_offer.notes: Top three A-levels only for standard tariff calculation; EPQ is not automatically counted.

contextual_offer.notes: No stable lower Medicine A100 contextual offer is published in the supplied dossier.

grade_requirements.notes: Requires Chemistry or Biology plus one further distinct science from Chemistry, Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

one_of_subject_groups.notes: At least one of Chemistry or Biology must be present.
The second science must be distinct from the first required subject.

subject_combination_rule.notes: Further Mathematics does not count toward the A*AA minimum when taken with Mathematics, and is not accepted as the second science if Mathematics is the second subject.

a_level.third_subject_rules: Any A-level is allowed in the supplied dossier; no excluded third subject is identified.
manual_review_overlays: Practical endorsement evidence, because the dossier does not publish a QMUL A100 rule.
a_level.notes: A*AA must be achieved in one sitting over a study period no longer than two years.

ib.notes: 37 overall with 666 at Higher Level, including Chemistry or Biology plus one further science.

higher_offer.notes: Three Highers at AAA including Chemistry and Biology.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: Two Advanced Highers at AA including Chemistry or Biology plus one further science.

scottish.notes: Scottish qualifications are official but remain a manual-review route in the generic classifier.

btec.notes: No BTEC route is implemented from the supplied QMUL dossier.

access_to_he.notes: No Access to HE route is implemented from the supplied QMUL dossier.

degree.notes: Graduates may apply to A100, but degree scoring and graduate-specific A100 cut-offs are unpublished.

international.notes: Country-specific international equivalencies are not encoded in this implementation.

post_16.notes: Standard A-level and IB school-leaver routes are executable. Scottish, graduate, resit and country-specific international equivalency routes require manual review boundaries.

ucat.minimum_total_score_basis: 2025 official UCAT 4th-decile boundary from shared data/ucat-deciles.json; review annually and do not present as a permanent QMUL cut-off.
ucat.notes: QMUL requires UCAT at or above the 4th decile and grants no UCAT exemptions. Stage 2 ranking uses UCAT but the exact UCAT/Tariff weighting is unpublished.

sjt.notes: SJT Bands 1-3 pass the gate. Band 4 is an automatic rejection.

conditions: A*AA must be achieved in one sitting over a study period of no longer than two years.
No separate GCSE resit restriction was found in the supplied dossier.
Resit applicants or applicants with incomplete sitting metadata require manual review.

exemptions: GCSE or IGCSE English Language grade 6/B
US High School Diploma Grade 12 English module delivered in the USA, where verified against QMUL equivalency table
manual_review_if: English Literature is used for required-subject presence but English Language evidence is missing.
International applicant relies on an unlisted English-language exemption.
english_language.notes: The shared classifier only checks the represented standard English evidence path; unlisted exemptions require manual review.

age_or_professional_checks.work_or_service_experience: People-focused care or service experience is required and may be explored at interview.
age_or_professional_checks.personal_statement: Collected and may inform interview discussion, but not scored before, during or after interview.
age_or_professional_checks.reference_policy: Academic reference is required where applicable; missing references may lead to rejection.

ranking_factors.notes: UCAT contributes to Stage 2 ranking, but QMUL does not publish the exact weighting.
UCAS Tariff, or weighted degree score for graduates, may contribute to Stage 2 ranking; exact weighting is unpublished.

total_score.notes: Do not calculate or display a QMUL official interview-ranking score. ApplySmart may display clearly labelled historical-normalised interview competitiveness estimates from the band configuration.

calculation.notes: The official weighted ranking exists, but the exact UCAT/Tariff formula and current 2700-scale cut-offs are unavailable. Under Engineering Standard 11, this supports labelled ApplySmart predictive estimates where official eligibility, official methodology and historical admissions data are present.

selection_adjustments.notes: Home and Overseas applicants are ranked separately.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Old 3600-scale historical cut-offs support ApplySmart-normalised 2700-scale guidance bands only. These estimates must not be presented as official QMUL thresholds, current-cycle cut-offs, guarantees of interview or offer predictions.

criteria: Other verified contextual or widening-participation flags
contextual_admissions.notes: Contextual status may be shown qualitatively, but no A100 numeric UCAT reduction, lower offer or guaranteed interview is encoded.

ranking_pools.name: QMUL Home standard school-leaver guidance
ranking_pools.notes: Historical Home interview cut-offs were 2720, 2620 and 2670 on the old 3600 scale for 2023-2025. ApplySmart normalises these for predictive guidance only; no official current 2700-scale QMUL threshold is claimed.

ranking_pools.name: QMUL Overseas school-leaver guidance
ranking_pools.notes: Historical Overseas interview cut-offs were 2870, 2950 and 2810 on the old 3600 scale for 2023-2025. ApplySmart normalises these for predictive guidance only; no official current 2700-scale QMUL threshold is claimed.
